title: October 18, 1861: Delhi's first-ever police complaint was written down - in Urdu and Persian.

sources.text: Deccan Herald - Delhi's first FIR was filed on this day 162 years ago
The Tribune - 163 years ago, first FIR in Delhi was on 45-anna theft

caption:
October 18, 1861: Delhi's first-ever police complaint was written down - in Urdu and Persian.

A resident named Maiuddin reported the theft of household items - women's clothing, a hookah, cooking pots, a bowl - valued at about 45 annas, roughly Rs 2.80 at the time.

Written partly in Urdu and partly in Persian - the official languages of court and police records at the time - a copy still survives today, preserved at the Delhi Police Museum.

A theft worth less than three rupees became the starting point for a record-keeping system that, over 165 years later, still structures how every crime in India gets reported and tracked.
